theorems.name: Submission.rsdic_tl_tangent_iff_of_density_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (r₀ : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → 0 < r₀ → μHE[n] (B ∩ closedBall x r₀) ≠ ∞ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μHE[n] ((B \ A) ∩ closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q
